description.value:
Prerequisites: Lay on Hands class feature

Whenever the white mage uses her lay on hands ability to inflict damage on undead, any undead touched must make a Will save (DC 10 + half of the white mage's level + her Wisdom modifier) against this ability or it flees from the white mage for a duration of 1 round + her Wisdom modifier.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
